# ClientForge

> ClientForge is an AI agency that helps Philadelphia businesses grow, automate and scale. We build websites, custom apps, AI automations and Meta ad campaigns for small and growing local businesses.

## Services
- Complete Brand Setup Package: website (up to 3 pages), logo, flyers, brand palette and social graphics. From $800 one-time. Delivered in under one week.
- AI automation: SMS and email lead follow-up, speed-to-lead replies, booking flows and CRM pipelines. From $250 one-time.
- Meta ads: campaign setup, targeting, 2 creatives a month and a monthly report. From $250 per month (management fee; client pays ad spend to Meta directly).
- Custom apps: dashboards, client portals and internal tools that the client owns. Quoted per project.
- Complete Business Package: 3 to 5 page website, branding, CRM, automation and ads built together. From $1,200 one-time.

All prices are starting points; final quotes depend on scope.

## Area served
Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
